title.original: Towards Understanding Bugs in Distributed Training and Inference Frameworks for Large Language Models
title.zh: 理解大型语言模型分布式训练与推理框架中的缺陷
title.en: Towards Understanding Bugs in Distributed Training and Inference Frameworks for Large Language Models

inclusion_reason.zh: 该研究发布跨三个主流框架的缺陷分类与修复模式，为分布式训练/推理的测试和自动修复工具提供可复用知识基础。
inclusion_reason.en: The study supplies a cross-framework defect taxonomy and repair patterns that reusable testing and automated-repair tools for distributed training and inference can build on.

abstract.zh: 该研究系统分析 DeepSpeed、Megatron-LM 和 Colossal-AI 的已修复缺陷，从症状、根因、定位成本和修复方式总结分布式训练与推理框架的可靠性模式。
abstract.en: This empirical study analyzes fixed defects from DeepSpeed, Megatron-LM, and Colossal-AI, characterizing symptoms, root causes, diagnosis effort, and repair patterns in distributed training and inference frameworks.

problem.zh: 框架复杂度快速上升，但缺少大样本证据说明缺陷如何表现、为何产生以及哪些修复可自动化，质量保障工具因而缺乏设计依据。
problem.en: Framework complexity is rising without large-sample evidence on how defects manifest, why they occur, or which repairs are automatable, leaving reliability tooling without a grounded design basis.

approach.zh: 作者整理三个项目的修复记录并人工编码，比较症状与根因、复现和修复投入、分布式特有错误以及常见低改动修复策略。
approach.en: The authors curate and manually code repairs from three projects, comparing symptoms with causes, reproduction and fix effort, distributed-specific failures, and recurring low-change repair strategies.

system_design.zh: 研究管线由缺陷采集、筛选、分类编码、跨框架统计和可自动化机会提炼组成，输出面向测试与修复系统的缺陷分类。
system_design.en: The study pipeline collects and filters defect reports, applies a coding taxonomy, aggregates patterns across frameworks, and derives opportunities for testing and automated repair.

key_results.zh: 分析揭示通信与资源分配等分布式特有根因，症状常与根因脱节；同时相当一部分修复遵循小范围条件、参数或兼容性修改。
key_results.en: The analysis identifies distributed-specific causes such as communication and allocation errors, a frequent symptom-cause disconnect, and many repairs that follow small conditional, parameter, or compatibility changes.

limitations.zh: 数据只包含公开且已修复的问题，受报告质量和项目选择偏差影响；历史统计不能直接检测新缺陷，也未覆盖闭源训练栈。
limitations.en: The dataset contains only public, fixed issues and inherits reporting and project-selection bias; historical patterns do not directly detect new defects and exclude proprietary stacks.

metrics.name: Bug fixes requiring no more than ten changed lines

notes.zh: 已填模型、工作负载、硬件、基线和指标均来自官方 arXiv 摘要或 comment；摘要未披露的表格明细、硬件拓扑与集群配置仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Populated models, workloads, hardware, baselines, and metrics come from the official arXiv abstract or comment; undisclosed table details, hardware topology, and cluster configuration still require full-text audit.
